outcome_story.paragraph: The full decision network made every search and handoff visible. Source-linked findings stayed attached to the reports that supported them. At difficult decisions, temporary report readers and checkers followed each named gap and recorded what they found. Across all eight runs, the network recorded which gaps triggered extra review and what each review returned. The unresolved paper-mill follow-up became the target for the action-card experiment.
